maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is dealer subscriptions for listings and marketplace services, plus CarOffer wholesale; not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private car dealerships subscribing to listings and by vehicle transaction fees; consumers and dealers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through its marketplace and dealer subscriptions; only occasional acquisitions such as CarOffer and Autolist.

mission_critical.reason: Dealers can shift listing spend among competing marketplaces like Autotrader and Cars.com; consumers switch sites freely.

notes: Dealers are somewhat reliant on CarGurus lead flow, but switching or multi-homing is easy.
